messages:
Ivy (sales): kicking off thread for Orion POC. Customer asks: long-policy summarization (~30k tokens), RAG Q&A with exact citations, and fast snippet reranking for their mobile app. Need acceptance criteria + model approach + rough Hosted vs Dedicated cost.
Ben (eng): noted. Constraints: EU data residency, KMS/HSM, no public egress for retrieval endpoints. Latency target: p50 < 180ms for snippet fetch.
Rowan (infra): Private EU deploy OK. Air-gapped adds ~2 weeks. Dedicated recommended for consistent low-latency reranker.
Nora (security): I'll take the questionnaire. Need data flow and retention limits from sales.
Ivy (sales): proposed acceptance criteria to share with client:
- Summaries: manual pass >= 90% on 40 samples + ROUGE-L >= 0.58
- QA: citation precision >= 0.85 and accuracy >= 0.80 on their eval set
- Rerank: NDCG@5 uplift >= 15% and p50 snippet latency < 180ms on Dedicated
- Security: Private EU + KMS/HSM + completed questionnaire
Ben (eng): model options to try:
- Option 1: native 32k LLM (quantized) for single-pass summaries and function-calls (best coherence, higher cost)
- Option 2: chunk->embed->retrieve->rerank + 8k LLM for answers (cheaper, lower hallucination)
- Reranker: small cross-encoder on Dedicated for low-latency ranking
Ben (eng): function-calling schema we'll test (strict validation).
Rowan (infra): action: confirm Hosted vs Dedicated quote after sales provides monthly token projection.
Nora (security): action: I'll return questionnaire answers by tomorrow noon.
Ivy (sales): action items: 1) sales to get token estimates from customer 2) eng to prepare 30-edge-case prompt bank + baseline outputs 3) infra to confirm pricing/timeline 4) security to complete questionnaire.
POC Bot: created workspace https://git.redwood/poc/orion and pushed eval harness.
Ivy (sales): i'll send this checklist to the customer and update here. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated slack thread for sales POC scoping; concise realistic messages; includes root + replies
